filters.title: Filters and performance
filters.description: The Enabled switch must be on for these options. Registry filtering limits dashboard metadata and is off by default because editors may need full lists. Visible-first graphs is also off by default: visible graphs start immediately, then off-screen graphs load after visible rendering and requests settle. Changes apply to open pages; reload the view to compare graph loading. Pause animations during loading temporarily pauses continuous dashboard motion and restores it automatically. It defaults to off. Resource filtering defaults to off. It limits Lovelace modules for selected accounts to the dashboard union, shared styles and optional exceptions. Review Resource dependencies to select any optional or unclassified modules you need. Hard-reload pages after changing this filter; already loaded modules cannot be unloaded.

compatibility.title: Loona cannot safely apply filtering
compatibility.description: Check the Compatibility problem sensor, the supported Home Assistant versions, and other integrations replacing entity, registry, or config commands. An affected feature preserves native handling when it cannot be installed. Reload browser pages after reloading Loona.

scope.title: Loona is passing through full data
scope.description: Both entity and registry filtering are bypassed while Scope problem is on, even when their switches are enabled. Check selected dashboards and active accounts in Loona options. Save automatically generated dashboards. Unsupported templates, dashboard strategies, unsupported auto-entities rules, or an empty scope prevent reliable filtering. Loona resumes filtering automatically after a complete scan. Download diagnostics for scan status.

exclusion.title: An exclusion removes a dashboard dependency
exclusion.description: Review Advanced entity rules in Loona options. Removing a referenced entity can break a card. Remove the exclusion or turn off Loona to restore its state.

resources.title: Loona resource dependencies need attention
resources.description: Resource filtering omits unchecked optional modules. Open Resource dependencies in Loona options to inspect unresolved custom types, dynamic configuration and missing selections. Required resources remain enabled automatically. If a card, icon or helper is missing, select its optional resource or turn off Resource filtering, then hard-reload. Saved resource registrations are preserved.
